caption: Camposanto Monumentale, Pisa
composition: Long white-marble Gothic cloister cemetery along the Piazza dei Miracoli lawn · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the Camposanto's long white-marble flank across the green lawn, its two tiers of Gothic arches running the length of the frame. Delicate tracery fills the upper arcade while blind arches line the ground floor, all glowing white in the sun. The 11:35 morning light is bright and clear under a blue sky, and the manicured grass of the Piazza dei Miracoli stretches empty in the foreground.
